about.body: The Ford EcoBoost (GTDI) is a 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-four petrol engine, sourced from Ford and fitted to the Jaguar XF during the X250 generation. It was produced from 2012 to 2015 as Jaguar's entry-level petrol option before the brand transitioned to its own Ingenium engine family. The engine uses direct injection and a turbocharger to deliver performance while maintaining efficiency.

byModel.body: Within Jaguar, the Ford EcoBoost is found in a single application - the XF (X250 generation, 2012-2015). During this period, it served as the 2.0-litre petrol option in the XF range, positioned alongside the 2.2-litre diesel and the 3.0-litre V6 petrol and diesel options. It was discontinued when Jaguar introduced the second-generation XF (X260) with its own Ingenium engines.

compatibility.body: The Ford EcoBoost in the Jaguar XF is a single-application engine - it was only fitted to the X250 generation XF between 2012 and 2015. Because the engine was sourced from Ford, it shares its base architecture with Ford applications, but the Jaguar-specific ancillaries, mounting, and ECU calibration differ. We confirm compatibility by registration/VIN before any rebuild or replacement.
